rules: Names from Wikipedia are leads only; original ecclesiastical, archaeological, historic, site-custodian sources required for assertions.
Cave of Patriarchs, Church of Holy Sepulchre and all nested chapels share parent complexes where physically appropriate.
A traditional grave is not authenticated bodily relic custody.
A Marian shrine is not proof that its attributed apparition was approved as supernatural.
No confessional ownership inferred from a generic Christian pilgrimage category.
A Holy Land locality such as Jerusalem or Galilee is not a standalone pin.
User-supplied URLs remain linked as discovery provenance; do not add these five to counts of independent institutionally verified primary sources.
